title: Odd magical triples and maximal Higgs bundles
summary: We introduce the notion of extended magical $\mathfrak{sl}_2$-triples, a generalization of the magical $\mathfrak{sl}_2$-triples in Bradlow--Collier--García-Prada--Gothen--Oliveira's work and show that, apart from the known even magical triples, there are precisely three odd triples of nontube type Hermitian Lie algebras that are extended magical. We then show that the Slodowy slice of an odd extended magical triple of $G^\textbf{R}$ in the $G^\textbf{R}$-Higgs bundle moduli space are precisely the maximal components.
